proposals.announcement_evidence: the contractor will complete their tailored concept design review in support of the Low Power Laser Demonstrator
proposals.rationale: Boeing's leg of the 2018 LPLD concept-design-review tranche, under HQ0277-18-C-0003. The Low Power Laser Demonstrator is named in the scope sentence, the index carries it once, on 0604115C 'Technology Maturation Initiatives', and fiscal 2018 research, development, test and evaluation funds are obligated against that RDT&E element. The deliverable is the demonstrator's own post-PDR risk-reduction design review.

refute_a.reason: This record is truncated before its funding sentence, so the appropriation is not stated here, but it is the third leg of the same FY2018 LPLD design-review tranche whose siblings (records 52 and 59) obligate RDT&E, and the deliverable is the demonstrator's own post-PDR design review, not O&M or generic services.

refute_b.reason: Boeing's leg under HQ0277-18-C-0003 on the same singly-owned name; the announcement names the demonstrator rather than relying on the contractor, and nothing in the index offers a second PE that could claim LPLD.

proposals.announcement_evidence: the contractor will perform Standard Missile-3 Block IB production support and engineering efforts
proposals.rationale: 'Standard Missile-3' is the spelled-out form of the designator the index carries as 'SM-3'; the row sits on MD09 (program title 'Aegis BMD'), the MDA procurement line that buys SM-3 rounds. The appropriation is the discriminator that makes this attributable rather than merely resembling: fiscal 2015 defense-wide procurement funds pay for Block IB production support, which belongs to a procurement BLI and not to the RDT&E rows that also carry SM-3 names under 0603892C. Block IB also separates it from MD14, the index's Block IIA procurement line. The work is production support for the missile itself, the line's own article of purchase.

refute_a.reason: Fiscal 2015 defense-wide procurement obligated against a procurement BLI — the money color both matches and is what separates this from the RDT&E SM-3 rows; production support and engineering for SM-3 Block IB is a cost element of the line that buys the round, so the named article is the item procured, not a platform supported.

refute_b.reason: 'SM-3' is a genuine two-PE collision (0603892C doc 267 and MD09 doc 95), but the announcement's own words resolve it without outside help: 'Block IB' excludes MD14's Block IIA line, and defense-wide procurement funds for production support exclude the RDT&E element, leaving MD09 as the only procurement owner of the designator.

proposals.announcement_evidence: the contractor will provide support of advanced concept initiatives by the Aegis Ballistic Missile Defense (ABMD) Program Office to identify technology for introduction into present and future ABMD baselines and upgrades
proposals.rationale: The May 2017 option exercise (CLIN 0110) of the same advanced-concept-initiatives scope: the announcement spells out Aegis Ballistic Missile Defense and abbreviates it ABMD, matching the index row 'Aegis Ballistic Missile Defense (BMD)' on 0603892C (AEGIS BMD). Identifying technology for introduction into present and future ABMD baselines and upgrades is the technology design and insertion activity this PE's narrative owns, performed on the Aegis BMD development contract itself, so the program is the article of work rather than a platform being supported.

refute_a.reason: No funding sentence survives in the truncated text, so the appropriation is not stated here; the CLIN 0110 option exercises the same ABMD technology-insertion scope on MDA's Aegis BMD development contract, which is 0603892C's own named activity (the identical scope in record 74 obligates RDT&E), and the PE is not a rollup.

refute_b.reason: Same three-way name collision as record 9, and resolved the same way — technology introduction into ABMD baselines and upgrades is the work 0603892C's own 'Technology Design and Insertion' row describes, while 0604878C is a test PE and MD90 a hardware BLI; the CLIN 0110 option is the same effort, not a different increment.

proposals.announcement_evidence: the contractor will produce two additional Lot 8 Interceptors and provide associated production support efforts for the Missile Defense Agency Terminal High Altitude Area Defense Project Office
proposals.lexicon_quote: The Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD)
proposals.rationale: THAAD is named in full, but what the announcement buys is Lot 8 interceptor production under fixed-price-incentive-firm-target contract line items — procurement of end items, not the development work that the RDT&E element 0603881C funds. Attaching interceptor production to an RDT&E line is the appropriation failure mode the refute pass exists to catch, and the index offers no THAAD procurement row to redirect it to: the only MD07 row is named AN/TPY-2, the radar, which this award does not buy. Recorded weak rather than forced onto either line.
